title: FinDER: Financial Dataset for Question Answering and Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.2: "we evaluate...using four state-of-the-art language models: GPT-o1 from OpenAI (Jaech et al., 2024)..."; Table 7 row GPT-o1.

prompt.note: "Prompts are kept minimal across all settings, presenting the context (if any) followed by the user query"; temperature 0.0; exact wording not quoted.

claim.metric: Response Correctness, Qualitative task, partial-information (top-10 retrieved) setting
claim.judge: llm:unspecified (RAGAS Correctness/Faithfulness scoring; judge model not named in the reviewed text)

data.source: FinDER benchmark introduced in this paper (financial QA over public filings); a related 500-query well-formed-question subsample is also used (Table 5)

notes: Test-set size for the main generation table (Table 7) is not stated in the reviewed text (only a separate 500-query subsample is sized, Table 5), so n_items and cost are approximate. GPT-o1 is also used non-experimentally to standardize gold draft answers during dataset construction (role A, Sec. 3).
